scope: harness-only debug tooling for the UAT device session; zero product-code changes; zero vision conflicts
built: 1. Show-only launch path: `--ez showOnly true` (long name navigator.harness.extra.SHOW_ONLY) brings the harness to the front via singleTop onNewIntent, refreshes the goal list/step log, registers custom-goal rows riding along, and NEVER starts or refuses a run (no loud-refusal log on this path). Behavior without the extra is unchanged.

2. Auto-return + buzz at ANY terminal (GOAL_ACHIEVED, BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, STUCK_KILL, REFUSED, GUARD_ABORT, USER_CANCEL, HARNESS_ERROR, TRIAGE_IMPOSSIBLE): startActivity(NEW_TASK|SINGLE_TOP|REORDER_TO_FRONT) from the run coroutine, one ~200ms one-shot vibration (VibratorManager.defaultVibrator, VibrationEffect.createOneShot, default attributes; no runtime permission needed), and the step-log LazyColumn scrolls to the newest entry (the verdict line).

3. Per-step progress notification: channel `navigator-debug` ('Navigator debug harness') created on harness launch; ONGOING notification (id 42) updated on every logged decision row with goal id (title) + step number + action summary (ids/kinds only - never typed text); at terminal replaced by a FINAL non-ongoing verdict notification; tapping opens HarnessActivity. POST_NOTIFICATIONS requested once on harness launch (Activity.requestPermissions); denial degrades gracefully (no crash, no notifications). Harness-debug only - no product notification code touched (Phase 9 owns that).

4. Custom goals visible in the harness: registered custom goals appear as rows in the on-screen goal list with a 'custom' prefix, the goal text, and 'expected: GOAL_ACHIEVED'; Run buttons work for them via the same runGoals/executeGoal path as the extras flow (custom+STUB refused loudly at run time for button launches).

5. FIX - per-run report missing shadow stats (uat-applepie-02): see rootCause. Every per-run report now ALWAYS includes the shadowReport object whenever the launch requested the shadow (any alias), incl. companionRows/droppedAfterClose/companionRejected/coverage/latencies, on STUCK_KILL/BUDGET terminals and on failure (failedReport) paths, snapshot taken after awaitIdle and survives router.close().

rootCause.primary: `--ez shadowOn true` was never a recognized extra: HarnessActivity read only navigator.harness.extra.SHADOW / short alias `shadow`. The launch silently ignored it, shadowOn stayed false, no ShadowRouter was built, and the run report was written by the normal path with the `shadow` property at its default null - which kotlinx.serialization Json(encodeDefaults=false) OMITS from the JSON entirely. Hence 'NO shadow/companion fields at all'. The pre-UAT sweep reports carried the object because they fired the recognized `--ez shadow true` alias. Corroborated by the real sweep reports: zero-valued DEFAULTED fields (droppedAfterClose, companionRejected) are also omitted there, proving the omit-when-default behavior.
rootCause.secondary: The failure path (runSelected catch -> failedReport: engine build failure, laya session open failure, goal timeout, loop exception) never captured the router snapshot - a shadow-on run dying off the happy path also lost the shadow block.
fixes: `shadowOn` recognized as a first-class alias (EXTRA_SHADOW_ON_SHORT); `shadow` and the long name unchanged.
Any unrecognized `navigator.harness.*` extra is now logged LOUDLY ('UNRECOGNIZED harness extra(s) ... IGNORED') - silent-ignore of typos is impossible again.

Per-run RunShadow holder: executeGoal registers it before anything can fail; the snapshot is captured in the loop's finally (awaitIdle -> snapshot -> close) and BOTH the success report and failedReport embed it. Degraded paths (no snapshot: session open failed / harness error before the loop / settle failure) embed a zeroed ShadowReport with a `note` explaining why - the block is never silently absent.
ShadowReport.companionRows/droppedAfterClose/companionRejected lost their `= 0` defaults so they ALWAYS encode (a missing key must never be ambiguous with zero when the owner reads coverage).

deviations: RunReport/ShadowReport/SuiteReport + the JSON serializers moved from HarnessActivity.kt into new harness/RunReports.kt (pure data, JVM-testable; the report JSON contract is now unit-gated). Harness-only refactor; output shape unchanged except the additive keys below.

ShadowReport gained `note: String? = null` (encoded only when set) for the degraded always-include paths; companionRows/droppedAfterClose/companionRejected lost their =0 defaults (always encoded now) - additive JSON keys only.

Goal-list Run buttons now run EXACTLY the picked goal; previously a registered custom goal REPLACED any row's run (requestedGoals replace semantics applied to button clicks, so a catalog-row Run would silently run the custom goal). The headless extras flow is unchanged: a custom goal still replaces the catalog selection for the launch.

The custom+STUB loud refusal for BUTTON-launched custom runs happens at run time (runGoal) instead of launch time; the headless launch-time refusal is unchanged; show-only never refuses (per the owner's requirement).
A relaunch carrying NO extras at all (e.g. tapping the notification) is now fully silent (previously logged 'launch ignored: no headless extras' on a live instance).

Smoke evidence uses goal dead-end-1 instead of the suggested search-and-read-1: search-and-read-1 reproducibly REFUSES on this AVD (documented loopback observation starvation, pre-UAT sweep); dead-end-1 exercises more steps and lands a STUCK_KILL terminal, which is on the required terminal list.
